cases.description: NB1 4XY, the full sample postcode: every counted topic has something recorded.

rule.source: FE-38, FE-39 and FE-41 (docs/product), as written in the Task 3 plan: counted topics only; found = recorded, stale or no-record-in-source; not known = records all source-failed (or mixed with not-covered); not covered = left out; one question per gap record, de-duplicated by topic and question text (the first record's id is kept); every record of the postcode belongs to exactly one counted topic; check in person lists every counted topic (whatever its outcome) and every route-only topic, in registry order, never counted

inputs.note: Registry from pilot-topics.json, records from postcode-area.json (synthetic).

steps.description: Counted topics, in registry order (family-view and the four route-only topics (five uncounted topics) are counted: false and ignored): getting-around, everyday-places, places-of-worship, schools, planning-nearby, flood, crime, sold-nearby, broadband, air-quality, radon, council-tax-by-band, housing-affordability, deprivation, transport-connectivity, green-space.
getting-around: transport-stop 1 to 3 and bus-departures 1 to 4 are all recorded, so found.

everyday-places: amenity 1 to 5 recorded (supermarket, park, pharmacy, gp-surgery, police-station) and amenity 10 recorded (a second gp-surgery), amenity 6 (childcare) is no-record-in-source. Found; only the childcare record gets a question, so amenity 10 changes no count.
places-of-worship: amenity 7, 8, 9 recorded, found.
schools: school 1 and 2 recorded, school-inspection 1 stale and 2 recorded, school-demand 1 and 2 recorded, found.
flood: FLOOD-1 is no-record-in-source and FLOOD-RISK-POSTCODE-1 is recorded, found; FLOOD-1 gets a question.

The other eleven counted topics each have recorded records only, found (planning-nearby, crime, sold-nearby, broadband (its broadband-coverage record), air-quality, radon, council-tax-by-band, housing-affordability (its affordability and council-rent records, both recorded), deprivation, transport-connectivity, green-space). radon: NB1-4XY-AREA-RADON-1 is recorded, so found with no question.

found 16, not known 0, coverage 16 of 16. Questions: only the two no-record-in-source records, in registry then file order; their (topic, text) pairs differ, so de-duplication removes nothing. The recorded radon record adds none.

Question text comes from each topic's gapQuestionTemplate, never from the record label. The only slot is {subject}: for everyday-places it is the plain name of the record's subtype from subtypeNames (childcare -> 'childcare provider', so 'Which childcare provider do people living here use, and how far away is it?'); every other topic's template has no slot, so its text is the template as written.

Check in person, in registry order: the 16 counted topics (whatever their outcome) and the four route-only topics (council-tax-band-home, mobile-by-network, noise, ground-and-mining). family-view is an uncounted grouping, not route-only, so it is left out. 16 + 4 = 20 lists; the lists are never counted (FE-41).

Ownership: every NB1 4XY record is read by exactly one counted topic (transport-stop and bus-departures: getting-around; amenity by subtype: everyday-places or places-of-worship; school, school-inspection, school-demand: schools; flood and flood-risk-postcode: flood; radon: radon; each other record topic: its one topic). family-view also reads school, school-demand and childcare and park amenities, but it is uncounted.

questions.text: Which childcare provider do people living here use, and how far away is it?
Has the home or the street ever flooded, and is there a flood history for the property?

cases.description: NB7 1RR, the sparse test postcode: gaps of every kind.

rule.source: FE-38, FE-39 and FE-41 (docs/product), as written in the Task 3 plan: counted topics only; found = recorded, stale or no-record-in-source; not known = records all source-failed (or mixed with not-covered); not covered = left out; one question per gap record, de-duplicated by topic and question text (the first record's id is kept); every record of the postcode belongs to exactly one counted topic; check in person lists every counted topic (whatever its outcome) and every route-only topic, in registry order, never counted

inputs.note: Registry from pilot-topics.json, records from postcode-area.json (synthetic).

steps.description: Same 16 counted topics as NB1 4XY.
getting-around: transport-stop 1 recorded, bus-departures 1 no-record-in-source. Found (any recorded), question for the bus-departures record.
everyday-places: amenity 2 (supermarket) no-record-in-source. Found, with a question. places-of-worship: amenity 1 recorded, found.
schools: school 1 recorded, school-demand 1 not-covered. Found, with a question for the not-covered record.

flood: FLOOD-1 and FLOOD-RISK-POSTCODE-1 are both source-failed: not known. Both are gaps, and the flood template has no slot, so both give the same text; de-duplicated by (flood, text), one question, keeping FLOOD-1 (first in file order).
transport-connectivity: its only record is source-failed: not known, one question. radon: its only record (NB7-1RR-AREA-RADON-1) is source-failed: not known, one question (the radon gap question).
green-space: its only record is not-covered: not covered, left out of found, not known and the total; still one question.

sold-nearby, broadband, air-quality and housing-affordability each hold no-record-in-source records (housing-affordability holds two: affordability and council-rent) (broadband: NB7-1RR-AREA-BROADBAND-COVERAGE-1): found, one question each. planning-nearby, crime, council-tax-by-band, deprivation and places-of-worship are recorded: found.

Found: getting-around, everyday-places, places-of-worship, schools, planning-nearby, crime, sold-nearby, broadband, air-quality, council-tax-by-band, housing-affordability, deprivation = 12 (broadband is found: no-record-in-source counts as found, FE-38). Not known = 3 (flood, radon, transport-connectivity). Coverage total 12 + 3 = 15. Gap records 13 (bus-departures 1, amenity 2, school-demand 1, flood 1, flood-risk-postcode 1, sold-price 1, broadband-coverage 1, air-quality 1, radon 1, affordability 1, council-rent 1, transport-connectivity 1, green-space 1). Two pairs share a (topic, text): the two flood records, and affordability with council-rent (one housing-affordability template, no slot, so the rent gap is deduplicated with the affordability gap, which comes first in file order and keeps its id). So 13 - 2 = 11 questions.

Question text comes from each topic's gapQuestionTemplate, never from the record label. The only slot is {subject}: for everyday-places it is the plain name of the record's subtype (supermarket -> 'supermarket'); every other topic's template has no slot, so its text is the template as written.

Check in person, in registry order: the 16 counted topics, including green-space (not covered: data can't show it, so checking in person matters most) and radon, and the four route-only topics; family-view left out. 20 lists, never counted.

questions.text: How do people living here usually get around, and which stops or services do they use?
Which supermarket do people living here use, and how far away is it?
Which schools do children living here usually go to, and how are places decided?
Has the home or the street ever flooded, and is there a flood history for the property?
Can you tell me about homes that have sold nearby recently and how they compare?
Which broadband provider and speed do people living here use, and how reliable is it?
What is the air like around the home on busy days and at busy times of day?
Has radon been measured in the home, and what was the result?
How do house prices here compare with what people earn locally, and how has that changed?
How do people living here usually travel for work and school?
Which green spaces can the public use near the home, and what are they like?

beta: not-covered + source-failed. Nothing found and not all not-covered, so not known. Two questions: their texts differ ('widget' and 'beta'), so both stay.
gamma: S2-G-1 is no-record-in-source, found, one question. delta: S2-D-1 is recorded, found, no question.
found 3 (alpha, gamma, delta), not known 1 (beta), coverage 3 of 4. Questions 4: S2-A-2, S2-B-1, S2-B-2, S2-G-1. Check in person: all four topics (all counted).

Question text: subject = subtypeNames[subtype] if the record has a subtype, else the topic name in lower case. S2-B-1 has subtype 'widget' (named 'widget'): 'Gap question about widget'. S2-A-2 -> alpha, S2-B-2 -> beta, S2-G-1 -> gamma.
